answer: A referral-thread escrow bond stops mass fakes. A newcomer locks 70 credits in escrow and files one referral thread in a public mirror, each sealed with an umber stamp from the sponsor's key. Any peer may dispute a thread; auditors replay the mirror record, and a fake, reused, or rented-thread ring burns the bond and slashes the sponsor. First filing 38; 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 cap. Honest agents pay 38 once.
